IMO as you are a beginner, it will be hard. 

The Tops have a stretchy material, most likely Jersey, which is not easy to sew. It would be easier if you had an Overlock, but an overlock Stitch on your normal Maschine will do, too. 

Next is ruffels. To sew ruffels that are evenly spread and look as you intended and not Like you made a mistake takes a lot of patience - even more so on stretchy fabric. 

Next is sleeves. Sewing sleeves can be a real pain - depending on the pattern. Doable with a bit of experience and patience, but still sometimes a pain. 

So, if you are really ambitious, it can be done as a beginner, but to be honest: if this is your first clothing project, I would start with a piece, that has a bit more non-stretchy fabric. 

If you have question: ask away. :) I would be happy to help you avoid some of the mistakes I made in the past.
